mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reviews (order_item_id, user_id, product_id, rating, content, images) VALUES (#{orderItemId}, #{userId}, #{productId}, #{rating}, #{content}, #{images})
mapper.select: SELECT r.*, u.username FROM reviews r LEFT JOIN users u ON r.user_id = u.id WHERE r.id = #{id}
SELECT r.*, u.username FROM reviews r LEFT JOIN users u ON r.user_id = u.id WHERE r.product_id = #{productId} ORDER BY r.created_at DESC
SELECT r.*, u.username FROM reviews r LEFT JOIN users u ON r.user_id = u.id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY r.created_at DESC
SELECT r.*, u.username FROM reviews r LEFT JOIN users u ON r.user_id = u.id WHERE r.order_item_id = #{orderItemId}
SELECT COALESCE(AVG(rating), 0) FROM reviews WHERE product_id = #{productId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reviews WHERE product_id = #{productId}
